items.name: Thermalright AXP120-X67
items.description: Low-profile CPU cooler with a nominal 123.5 x 120 x 67 mm cooler envelope. required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: choose the socket-compatible retail variant for the final motherboard/CPU.
items.selection_reason: Named cooler in the confirmed PRD; retain the user-measured installed-height correction and the 8 mm motherboard-side enclosure extension when validating CAD fit.

The card is inverted with PCIe fingers upward. Its 106 mm rear dual-slot opening spans Z=84.99..190.99 mm, with the lower edge aligned to the motherboard rear-I/O opening lower edge; the card body remains 7.5 mm below the bracket datum at Z=77.49 mm.

items.selection_reason: Matches the current user-specified GPU and physical measurements while retaining the active decision that the card is dual-slot and the user will handle power cabling.

items.name: 10 x 5 x 2 mm plain rectangular magnets
items.description: Eight unperforated rectangular magnets bonded into compact screwless pockets: four on the front end panel and four on the rear end panel.
required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: verify actual 10 x 5 x 2 mm dimensions, polarity and coating before ordering.
items.supply_risk: Commercial magnet dimensional tolerance and coating thickness vary; dry-fit one magnet in the 10.5 x 5.5 x 2.0 mm CAD pocket before bonding the full set.
items.selection_reason: The user explicitly corrected the retained design to eight 10 x 5 x 2 mm adhesive magnets with no magnet-retention screws; the surrounding front and rear carriers are simplified only.

items.name: 10 x 10 x 1 mm steel strike plates
items.description: Eight plain ferromagnetic plates bonded into the compact inner-face recesses of the removable left and right side panels, four per side panel.
required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: verify the plates are ferromagnetic and fit the 10.3 x 10.3 x 1.15 mm CAD recesses.
items.supply_risk: Plate flatness, coating and adhesive thickness can reduce magnetic contact; test one assembled front/rear station before bonding all eight plates.
items.selection_reason: The confirmed panel-retention requirement uses matching steel strike features on the two removable side panels; dimensions match the current CAD strike-pocket parameters.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 8 socket-head screw
items.description: Seven M3 x 8 socket-head screws: four fasten the rear panel to the rear screw spines, and three fasten the Mini-ITX motherboard directly to the three retained 6.35 mm integrated printed supports.
items.selection_reason: Current requirements retain three integrated motherboard support points and four rear-panel screw joints. printed-screw-joint-v1 resolves the rear-lower and two upper motherboard fasteners to M3 x 8; no independent motherboard-mount plate screws remain.

items.name: M3 x 10 hex-drive conical countersunk screw
items.description: Four flat-head screws fasten the top cap to the printed corner blocks. The user-measured maximum head diameter is 5.8 mm; the true conical kit-derived seats have approximately 6.12 mm entry diameter and finish flush with the top exterior surface.
items.selection_reason: CAD build 517 retains four printed-screw-joint-v1 top corner joints resolved to M3 x 10 with true conical seats. A 0.20 mm offset of the exact kit cut accommodates the user-measured 5.8 mm maximum head diameter without replacing the kit geometry.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 4 socket-head screw
items.description: Two screws are inserted from below, pass upward through the GPU bracket ears, and engage the through-threaded rear-panel flange.
items.selection_reason: The current motherboard fasteners are three M3 x 8 screws and are listed separately. The standard 0.8 mm GPU bracket ears beneath the 3.2 mm printed flange still resolve through printed-screw-joint-v1 to two M3 x 4 screws for bottom-to-top insertion.

items.name: M3 x 12 hex-drive conical countersunk screw
items.description: Four flat-head screws enter from the undersides of four independently printed Ø16 x 4 mm feet with 1.2 mm rounded outer edges. The user-measured maximum head diameter is 5.8 mm; the enlarged true-conical kit-derived exterior foot entries measure approximately 6.717 mm, providing about 0.917 mm total diametral insertion clearance. Each seat is recessed an additional 1.2 mm, then the screw passes through one foot and the base and engages the matching lower front/rear-panel block, clamping all three printed parts.
items.selection_reason: CAD build 519 retains four printed-screw-joint-v1 bottom corner joints resolved to M3 x 12. Based on the user's physical insertion feedback, the exact kit cuts are offset 0.45 mm for the foot-side exterior entries, producing approximately 6.717 mm openings for the measured 5.8 mm heads, and remain translated upward 1.2 mm to preserve usable reach without hand-modeling the screw hole. The top-cap cuts remain at their previous 0.20 mm offset.

items.name: Tmall item 655230136762 panel-mount power button
items.description: User-selected front-panel power button from Tmall item 655230136762. The user has confirmed the selected product is the Φ8 mm mounting variant; the current FDM design default uses an 8.2 mm target printed-panel cutout.
required_user_evidence: Advisory fit reminder: measure the received Φ8 mm button's threaded-body diameter and calibrate the printed test hole before the production front-panel print.
items.supply_risk: The login-gated listing prevented verification of threaded-body length, bezel diameter, rear terminal envelope and cable exit. These remain physical dry-fit checks, but do not block the current CAD because the button body and internal cable path are outside its scope.
items.selection_reason: Preserves the exact Tmall listing supplied by the user and records the user's subsequent confirmation that the selected product is the Φ8 mm mounting variant.

supply_risks.description: The motherboard and GPU identities are fixed by the current PRD. The exact commercial SFX PSU remains user-selected but is constrained by the standard 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm envelope and rear interface.
Dry-fit one 10 x 5 x 2 mm magnet and one 10 x 10 x 1 mm steel strike in the printed pockets before bonding all eight stations; verify dimensional tolerance, polarity, coating and adhesive thickness.

Print one M3 self-forming-hole coupon and one independent-foot corner stack in the final material and process before production. Use the actual measured 5.8 mm conical flat-head screw to confirm the approximately 6.12 mm top entry and enlarged approximately 6.717 mm foot entry both seat correctly, the foot screw can be inserted from the exterior without force, the screw clamps foot/base/end-panel without a gap, and the printed edge does not split.
